title: Resident Evil
provenance: Reported by Themio1998 (highball-db#252, 2026-09-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, D3DMetal, DLL overrides as typed version=n,b;winmm-n,b;dinput8=n,b, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. notanalogrithim (highball-db#1341, 2026-11-20), Apple M3, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 101 minutes: the Steam id given, Retina pixels at 100%, a 60 fps cap and the steam, controller-sdl, vcrun2022 and xact recipes. Frame drops and stutter on entering a new room or when new lighting first shows, such as lightning lighting up a room, which the player puts down to shaders compiling.
notes: The 2015 HD Remaster of the 2002 remake. Reported playable on D3DMetal on an M1 with the default engine r11 after a three-minute session, with a smooth frame rate by the reporter's account. DXMT and DXVK were not tried. Nothing was measured here. An M3 rated it playable over 101 minutes on the default engine r28, D3DMetal by the report in an environment in DXMT mode, with frame drops and stutter the first time a room or new lighting shows, such as lightning (highball-db#1341).

knownIssues.symptom: A pause the first time a door animation or the menu loads, quick after that (reported). A player on an M3 saw frame drops and stutter on entering a new room or when new lighting first shows, such as lightning (highball-db#1341).
knownIssues.cause: most likely shaders compiling on first use, not measured here.
knownIssues.fix: none needed, it goes away after the first time.

knownIssues.symptom: Minor graphical glitches during door animations and in some locations (reported on D3DMetal).
knownIssues.cause: not looked at here, the reporter suspects the graphics mode.
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. DXMT is the other mode to try.
